hypothesis: Existing immutable Mandarin prepared clean recording and construction metadata uniquely reproduce the known engineering near/echo mixture; exact sample equality admits a derived near reference for later separately frozen diagnostics
data_role: single inspected development utterance plus first-party synthetic echo, no independent corpus or human label claim
method: Verify original preparation file hashes; obtain 68496 original S16 samples from clean_mono[8000:76496], verify all padding zero and duplicate clean mic channels; derive near=round(original*0.5) placed at16000, total100640; derive each echo from saved render with original double taps and round/clamp16; compare exact unclipped sum to both existing capture channels and mono; no alignment search
acceptance: All source hash/length/recipe checks and all201280 capture sample equalities must pass; reconstructed sums must fit S16, no tolerance; on any mismatch stop, no recipe tuning
negative_controls: one-sample near alteration and one-sample echo alteration must each fail mixture equality
not_claimed: Chinese quality benefit, DTD correctness, physical echo/near truth, production/SSC305 readiness
